meta.title: Rewilding — Liminal Forests Alliance
meta.description: Working plantations, logged leases, pasture and farm lots tracked for restoration. Critical cards flag high ecological urgency (corridor edges, rare biomes, deforestation frontiers). Separate from wild land on Old Growth.
meta.intro: These are broker listings of working plantations, logged leases, pasture and farm lots. We track them because they could be restored rather than intensified. Cards marked Critical sit on a known ecological priority — a protected-area edge, rare biome, or deforestation frontier — based only on facts stated on the listing or public protected-area adjacency named there. Every fact on a card comes from the broker’s listing. This page is not an offer of sale, and foreign-ownership rules often apply — see each card’s tenure note.
